description.value:
Enemies affected by your Protector's Mark have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you while they are within 30 feet of you.

Additionally, if an affected enemy attacks a creature other than you while within that range, you can use your Reaction to move up to your Speed and make a weapon attack against that enemy. If you are mounted, your mount moves up to its own Speed instead. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1) and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Alternatively, you can spend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to regain a use of this feature (no action required).
